# Dependency versions and licenses

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

This inventory was first verified on Apple Silicon with macOS 26.5.2, SDK 26.5, and Python 3.12. Python environments are installed by feature. Each `.in` lists direct requirements and the matching `.lock` records resolved versions. PyPI archives have hashes except in the MOSS environment. Git dependencies are pinned to specific commits.

`scripts/fetch_model.py` checks SHA-256 for direct model downloads. The Omni installer checks the disk image, app signature, notarization, and model weights. Depth Anything verifies the Core ML package before compiling it. The MOSS package imports PyTorch and runs this transcription path with MLX. Hy-MT2 and Privacy Filter build from pinned Git revisions and install runtime dependencies from hashed locks.

Apple Vision, PDFKit, Speech, Translation, Natural Language, and Foundation Models come with macOS. macOS manages its own models and language assets. The optional `apple-fm-python` backend uses Apple Python SDK 0.2.2, ctypesgen 1.1.1, and the selected macOS SDK to compile the Swift-C bindings. [Apple Python SDK package](https://pypi.org/project/apple-fm-sdk/0.2.2/) · [LFM dependency locks](../backends/lfm/README.md)
